This script reproduces **Table 1: cohort characteristics**. It reuses the setup below; objects from earlier analyses may be required (see ../README.md for the run order), or knit `analysis/MASLD_main_manuscript_analysis.Rmd` as a whole. Source Data are written to `results/source_data/`.

# 1. Setup

Packages, paths, significance thresholds and helper functions. Inputs are read from `data/`; tables and figures are written to `results/`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  warning = FALSE
)

# ---- Paths -------------------------------------------------------------
# Raw input files are read from data/ (not included in the repository, see data/README.md) and everything
# that is written goes to results/. Both are resolved once, to absolute paths, in this order:
#   1. environment variable MASLD_DATA_DIR / MASLD_RESULTS_DIR
#   2. ../data and ../results (this file lives in analysis/), or data/ and results/ in the working directory
.cands <- c(Sys.getenv("MASLD_DATA_DIR", unset = NA), "../data", "data")
.cands <- .cands[!is.na(.cands) & nzchar(.cands)]
.hit <- .cands[dir.exists(.cands)]
if (!length(.hit)) stop("Input folder not found. Set it first, e.g.\n  Sys.setenv(MASLD_DATA_DIR = \"/path/to/folder/with/Analyisis\")")
project_dir <- normalizePath(.hit[1])
.res <- Sys.getenv("MASLD_RESULTS_DIR",
                   unset = if (basename(project_dir) == "data") file.path(dirname(project_dir), "results") else file.path(project_dir, "results"))
dir.create(file.path(.res, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
results_dir <- normalizePath(.res)
OUT_DIR <- results_dir                           # used by the Table 1 chunk
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = results_dir)     # relative output paths land in results/
setwd(results_dir)                               # same when run chunk by chunk in the console
message("Input folder:  ", project_dir, "\nResults folder: ", results_dir)

# Supplementary Tables workbook (published with the paper); only used to read Table S3 (curated lipid names)
# and to compare column names of the tables written below.
SUPP_XLSX <- Sys.getenv("MASLD_SUPP_XLSX", unset = file.path(project_dir, "gupta_MASLD_SupplementaryTables.xlsx"))

# ---- Significance thresholds (Benjamini-Hochberg FDR) -------------------
FDR_GENE  <- 0.05   # DESeq2 genes (Table S1, Figs 1, 3, 6) and external replication (Tables S5-S7)
FDR_OMICS <- 0.10   # limma lipids and metabolites (Tables S3, S4, S10a, S10b, S11, S12, S19, S20)
FDR_KEGG  <- 0.10   # KEGG enrichment, at least 3 genes (Table S2b, Table S7)

# ---- Supplementary tables are collected in manuscript order ---------------
SUPP <- list()
add_table <- function(name, x) {
  SUPP[[name]] <<- x
  if (is.data.frame(x)) {
    write.csv(x, file.path(results_dir, "tables", paste0(gsub(" ", "_", name), ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  } else for (lab in names(x)) if (is.data.frame(x[[lab]]))
    write.csv(x[[lab]], file.path(results_dir, "tables", paste0(gsub(" ", "_", name), "_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", lab), ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  invisible(x)
}

# Source Data workbooks (Nature style: one sheet per figure panel) -> results/source_data/
sd_panel <- function(name, desc, data) list(name = name, desc = desc, data = as.data.frame(data))
write_source_data <- function(file, panels) {
  dir.create(file.path(results_dir, "source_data"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
  for (p in panels) {
    sh <- substr(p$name, 1, 31)
    openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, sh)
    openxlsx::writeData(wb, sh, p$desc, startRow = 1)
    openxlsx::writeData(wb, sh, p$data, startRow = 3)
  }
  openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb, file.path(results_dir, "source_data", file), overwrite = TRUE)
  message("Wrote source data: ", file)
}

# dotplot of an enrichment result; returns NULL (instead of an error) when nothing is enriched
safe_dotplot <- function(x, ...) {
  if (is.null(x) || nrow(as.data.frame(x)) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
  enrichplot::dotplot(x, ...)
}
```

# 2. Cohort: Table 1

Participant characteristics of the 211 adults.

```{r cohort-01}
phenotype <- data.frame(readxl::read_excel(file.path(project_dir, "Analyisis/Metadata.xlsx")))
rownames(phenotype) <- phenotype$id
phenotype <- phenotype[,-1]
phenotype <- phenotype %>%
  rename(
    Age = Age_yr, BMI = BMI_kgm2, Menopause = Menopause_YN,
    Glucose = Glucose_mgdL, HbA1c = HbA1c_percent,
    AST = AST_UL, ALT = ALT_UL, GGT = GGT_UL,
    Cholesterol = Cholesterol_mgdL, HDL = HDL_mgdL, LDL = LDL_mgdL,
    TG = TG_mgdL,
    Steatosis = steatosis_Kleiner, Inflammation = inflammation_Kleiner,
    MASH = NASH_Kleiner_YN, Fibrosis = fibrosis_Kleiner_04,
    Gender = Gender_M0F1
  )
# --------------------------------------------------------- sex decode ------
# Gender_M0F1 is named as though numeric but holds "Male"/"Female" strings.
# Handle either, then verify before using.
decode_sex <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    ifelse(x == 0, "Male", "Female")
  } else {
    ifelse(grepl("^m", as.character(x), ignore.case = TRUE), "Male", "Female")
  }
}
phenotype$Sex <- factor(decode_sex(phenotype$Gender),
                        levels = c("Female", "Male"))
if (!setequal(as.integer(table(phenotype$Sex)), c(57L, 154L)))
  stop("Sex decode failed - expected 57 men / 154 women.")
.prev <- tapply(as.integer(phenotype$Steatosis != 0), phenotype$Sex, mean)
if (names(which.max(.prev)) != "Male")
  stop("Sex labels are inverted - men should have the higher steatosis prevalence.")
message("Sex decode verified: 154 women, 57 men.")
# ------------------------------------------------------------ recode -------
cat("\nRaw coding check — confirm before trusting the labels below:\n")
for (v in c("Steatosis", "Inflammation", "Fibrosis", "MASH", "Menopause")) {
  cat(sprintf("  %-13s ", v)); print(table(phenotype[[v]], useNA = "ifany"))
}
phenotype <- phenotype %>%
  mutate(
    Steatosis_grade = factor(Steatosis, levels = 0:3,
      labels = c("Grade 0", "Grade 1",
                 "Grade 2", "Grade 3")),
    Inflammation_grade = factor(Inflammation, levels = 0:3,
      labels = c("Grade 0", "Grade 1",
                 "Grade 2", "Grade 3")),
    Fibrosis_stage = factor(Fibrosis, levels = 0:4,
      labels = c("Stage 0", "Stage 1", "Stage 2",
                 "Stage 3", "Stage 4")),
    Steatosis_bin    = factor(ifelse(Steatosis    == 0, "No", "Yes"),
                              levels = c("No", "Yes")),
    Inflammation_bin = factor(ifelse(Inflammation == 0, "No", "Yes"),
                              levels = c("No", "Yes")),
    Fibrosis_bin     = factor(ifelse(Fibrosis     == 0, "No", "Yes"),
                              levels = c("No", "Yes")),
    # Edit if MASH is coded other than 0/1
    MASH_lab = factor(ifelse(MASH == 1, "Yes", "No"), levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.factor), droplevels))
# ------------------------------------------------------------- table -------
table1 <- tbl_summary(
  phenotype,
  by = Sex,
  include = c(Age, BMI, Glucose, HbA1c, AST, ALT, GGT,
              Cholesterol, HDL, LDL, TG,
              Steatosis_grade, Inflammation_grade, Fibrosis_stage, MASH_lab,
              Steatosis_bin, Inflammation_bin, Fibrosis_bin),
  label = list(
    Age                ~ "Age, years",
    BMI                ~ "Body mass index, kg/m\u00b2",
    Glucose            ~ "Fasting glucose, mg/dL",
    HbA1c              ~ "HbA1c, %",
    AST                ~ "AST, U/L",
    ALT                ~ "ALT, U/L",
    GGT                ~ "GGT, U/L",
    Cholesterol        ~ "Total cholesterol, mg/dL",
    HDL                ~ "HDL cholesterol, mg/dL",
    LDL                ~ "LDL cholesterol, mg/dL",
    TG                 ~ "Triglycerides, mg/dL",
    Steatosis_grade    ~ "Hepatic steatosis grade",
    Inflammation_grade ~ "Lobular inflammation grade",
    Fibrosis_stage     ~ "Fibrosis stage",
    MASH_lab           ~ "Histologically definite MASH",
    Steatosis_bin      ~ "Steatosis \u2265 grade 1",
    Inflammation_bin   ~ "Lobular inflammation \u2265 grade 1",
    Fibrosis_bin       ~ "Fibrosis \u2265 stage 1"
  ),
  statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
                   all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),
  digits = list(all_continuous() ~ 1),
  missing_text = "Missing"
) %>%
  add_n() %>%
  add_overall(col_label = "**All participants**  \nN = {N}") %>%
  add_p(test = list(all_continuous()  ~ "wilcox.test",
                    all_categorical() ~ "chisq.test")) %>%
  modify_header(label = "**Characteristic**") %>%
  bold_labels()
table1
# ------------------------------------------------------------- export ------
caption <- paste(
  "Table 1. Clinical, biochemical and histological characteristics of the",
  "study cohort, by sex."
)
footnotes <- c(
  "Continuous variables are median (Q1, Q3); categorical variables are n (%).",
  paste("P values from the Wilcoxon rank-sum test (continuous) and Pearson's",
        "chi-squared test (categorical); not adjusted for multiple comparisons."),
  paste("Histological features were graded on liver biopsy using the Kleiner",
        "scoring system. Steatosis, lobular inflammation and fibrosis were",
        "dichotomised (grade/stage 0 vs \u2265 1) for all downstream analyses."),
  paste("Of 154 women, 119 (77%) were pre-menopausal and 35 (23%)",
        "post-menopausal; menopausal status is not applicable to men and is",
        "therefore not tabulated."),
  "AST, aspartate aminotransferase; ALT, alanine aminotransferase; GGT, gamma-glutamyl transferase; MASH, metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis."
)
if (requireNamespace("flextable", quietly = TRUE)) {
  ft <- gtsummary::as_flex_table(table1)
  ft <- flextable::set_caption(ft, caption)
  for (f in rev(footnotes)) {
    ft <- flextable::add_footer_lines(ft, values = f)
  }
  ft <- flextable::fontsize(ft, size = 9, part = "all")
  ft <- flextable::fontsize(ft, size = 8, part = "footer")
  ft <- flextable::font(ft, fontname = "Arial", part = "all")
  ft <- flextable::autofit(ft)
  flextable::save_as_docx(ft, path = file.path(OUT_DIR, "Table1.docx"))
  flextable::save_as_html(ft, path = file.path(OUT_DIR, "Table1.html"))
  message("Wrote Table1.docx and Table1.html")
} else {
  message("flextable not installed - install.packages('flextable') for .docx output")
}
readr_ok <- requireNamespace("readr", quietly = TRUE)
tbl_df <- gtsummary::as_tibble(table1)
utils::write.csv(tbl_df, "Table1.csv", row.names = FALSE)
message("Wrote Table1.csv")
phenotype <- data.frame(readxl::read_excel(file.path(project_dir, "Analyisis/Metadata.xlsx")))
rownames(phenotype) <- phenotype$id
phenotype <- phenotype[,-1]
```
